# Municipal Ordinance No. 003, Series of 2013

**An Ordinance Abolishing the Position of Administrative Aide 1, SG-1 Under the Office of the Sangguniang Bayan in the Municipality of Pitogo, Quezon**

Resolution No. 054

## Summary

Abolishes the position of Administrative Aide 1 (Salary Grade 1, Item No. 13) under the [[Office of the Sangguniang Bayan]] in the [[Municipality of Pitogo]]. The position became vacant due to the promotion of the former occupying personnel. Motioned by [[John Paul H. Budao]], seconded by [[Cristina D. Esconia]].

## Key Provisions

- **Position Abolished:** Administrative Aide 1 (SG-1, Item No. 13) under the Office of the Sangguniang Bayan
- **Reason for Abolition:** Position became vacant due to promotion of the former occupying personnel
- **Legal Authority:** Per [[Sec-76-RA7160]] on organizational structure and staffing pattern
